actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Confluence action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Confluence connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_page_v2
actions.title: Create page (API v2)
actions.help: Creates a new page in Confluence. Pages are created as published by default unless specified as a draft in the Status field. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: space_id
input.label: Space ID
input.hint: ID of the space where the page will be created

input.name: title
input.label: Title
input.hint: Title of the page.

properties.name: value
properties.label: Content
properties.hint: Content of the page in the format found in the representation field.

properties.name: representation
properties.label: Representation
properties.hint: Select the format for the content. Defaults to 'storage', if not specified.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Parent ID
input.hint: ID of the parent content.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Status of the page.

actions.name: create_task_v2
actions.title: Create task (API v2)
actions.help: Creates an inline task on a Confluence page by appending it to the page's content. Provide the page ID and the task body. Optionally, assign the task to a user by specifying an Atlassian account ID, set a due date, or mark it as complete. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom A…

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: ID of the page where the task will be created.

input.name: body
input.label: Task
input.hint: Body/description of the task.

input.name: task_status
input.label: Task status
input.hint: Status of the task. Defaults to 'incomplete' if not specified.

input.name: assignee_id
input.label: Assignee account ID
input.hint: Atlassian account ID of the user to assign the task to.

input.name: due_date
input.label: Due date
input.hint: Due date for the task.

actions.name: get_ancestors_for_page
actions.title: Get ancestors for page
actions.description: Get ancestors for page in Confluence
actions.help: Retrieves ancestors for a specific page in top-to-bottom order. Additional results (if available) can be retrieved by invoking this action with the ID of first ancestor in the response. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: ID of the page whose ancestors are to be retrieved.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of ancestors to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

actions.name: get_attachments_for_page
actions.title: Get attachments for page
actions.description: Get attachments for page in Confluence
actions.help: Retrieves attachments for a specific page in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: The ID of the page for which attachments should be returned.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

input.name: cursor
input.label: Cursor
input.hint: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the 'Next page cursor' field in response.

actions.name: get_children_for_page
actions.title: Get children for page
actions.description: Get children for page in Confluence
actions.help: Retrieves children for a specific page in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: ID of the page whose children are to be retrieved.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

input.name: cursor
input.label: Cursor
input.hint: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the 'Next page cursor' field in response.

actions.name: get_page_by_id
actions.title: Get page by ID
actions.description: Get page by ID in Confluence
actions.help: Retrieves a page by its ID in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: ID of the page to retrieve

input.name: body_format
input.label: Body format
input.hint: Format of the page body to retrieve. Defaults to 'storage' if not specified.

input.name: version
input.label: Version
input.hint: Version number of the page to retrieve. If not specified, the latest version is retrieved.

actions.name: search_content_cql
actions.title: Search content with CQL
actions.description: Search content with CQL in Confluence
actions.help: Searches for content in Confluence using a Confluence Query Language (CQL) expression. Supports Confluence Cloud only.

input.name: cql
input.label: CQL
input.hint: Confluence Query Language expression, e.g. type=page AND space in (IT,RUNBOOKS) AND text ~ "vpn outage" .

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

input.name: cursor
input.label: Cursor
input.hint: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the 'Next page cursor' field in response.

actions.name: search_labels
actions.title: Search labels
actions.help: Searches for labels in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: label_id
input.label: Label IDs
input.hint: Filters on label ID. Multiple IDs can be specified as a comma-separated list.

input.name: prefix
input.label: Label prefixes
input.hint: Filters on label prefix. Multiple prefixes can be specified as a comma-separated list.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

input.name: cursor
input.label: Cursor
input.hint: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the 'Next page cursor' field in response.

input.name: text
input.label: Text
input.hint: Keyword of the page's content to search page

actions.name: search_spaces
actions.title: Search spaces
actions.help: Searches for spaces in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: Type of spaces to retrieve.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Status of spaces to retrieve.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Maximum number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 25 if not specified. Minimum is 1, maximum is 250.

input.name: cursor
input.label: Cursor
input.hint: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the 'Next page cursor' field in response.

actions.name: update_page
actions.title: Update page
actions.help: Updates an existing page in Confluence. Supports Confluence Cloud only. For Data Center, use Custom Actions.

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: ID of the page to update.

properties.name: value
properties.label: Content
properties.hint: New content of the page in the format found in the representation field.If not provided, the latest version of the page content will be used.

properties.name: representation
properties.label: Representation
properties.hint: Select the format for the content. Defaults to 'storage', if not specified.

input.name: title
input.label: Title
input.hint: New title of the page.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: New status of the page.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Parent ID
input.hint: ID of the parent content. This allows the page to be moved under a different parent within the same space.

input.name: owner_id
input.label: Owner ID
input.hint: Account ID of the page owner. This allows page ownership to be transferred to another user.
